## Description

Supplemental geometry referenced by PMI `geometric_item_specific_usage` must use the `constructive_geometry_representation` as `used_representation`. If the writer uses the part's `shape_representation` instead, the PMI link is invalid.

## Reproducer recipe

PMI element references a supplemental plane via GISU whose `used_representation` is the `advanced_brep_shape_representation` of the manufactured shape, not the CGR.

## Expected kernel behavior

kernel must check `used_representation` actually contains the referenced item.
